# AI Governance Practitioner (EU AI Act · NIST AI RMF · ISO 42001) — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Classify 15 systems

*Module 1: Inventory and classification · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_classify_fifteen_systems.py`): Build your own register (15 rows minimum — include vendor tools with embedded AI). Classify by hand, then with /tools → Governance. Reconcile every difference.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Gap assessment

*Module 2: Frameworks in depth · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_gap_assessment.py`): Run the assessment for your organisation at /tools → Governance with honest gap answers. Pick the five controls that close the most high-risk gaps.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Run a mock review

*Module 3: Review, documentation, oversight · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_mock_review_board.py`): Run the board: one person presents the system, three review (risk, legal, security). Use the pack checklist. Record the decision and conditions in writing.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Audit plan

*Module 4: Auditing AI · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_audit_plan_and_bias_test.py`): Write the audit plan for one high-risk system: scope, five evidence requests, two tests you will re-perform yourself. Run the bias test on real or synthetic outcomes.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
